meta.name: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
meta.description: Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and the Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku. Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an Earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

videos.title: The God Who Destroys
videos.overview: Years after the battle with Earth's greatest enemy, Majin Buu, the planet's savior Son Goku spends his days in peace. Meanwhile, on a distant planet, the God of Destruction Beerus awakens from his long slumber!

videos.title: The God of Destruction Heads to the Planet of the Kai
videos.overview: Elder Supreme Kai and Supreme Kai Kibito learn of the awakening of the almighty Beerus. Meanwhile, the God of Destruction heads to the Planet of the Kai to find out about the "Super Saiyan God" he saw in a prophetic dream and...?!

videos.title: The God of Destruction Heads to Earth
videos.overview: After facing off with Goku, Beerus heads to Earth seeking other Saiyans. On Earth, Goku's companions have gathered to celebrate Bulma's birthday. When Vegeta sees Beerus, the terror of the God of Destruction resurfaces in his mind...!

videos.title: The God of Saiyans
videos.overview: Over a trivial matter, Beerus decides to destroy Earth. In this desperate situation, Goku suggests asking Shenron about the "Super Saiyan God" that Beerus seeks. Is it possible to create this warrior, considered a mythical god?!

videos.title: The God of Destruction and Son Goku
videos.overview: With everyone's help, Goku transforms into a "Super Saiyan God"! With Earth's fate on the line, the fierce battle between Goku, with his unknown god powers, and the God of Destruction Beerus begins!

videos.title: Battle of Gods
videos.overview: In the "Battle of Gods" between the Super Saiyan God and the God of Destruction, Goku loses his god powers. Against Beerus and his overwhelming strength, Goku faces absolute peril! How will this ultimate battle over Earth's fate end...?!
